inference: For each tree, walk feature<=threshold ? left : right to a leaf, read its `probs` vector (indexed by `classes`), average probs across all trees -> final class-probability vector. n_trees=100 -- exported JSON size and per-window latency for this scale are in the accompanying results row, not assumed.

feature_normalization.description: Per task: z-score each raw feature using mean/std from sliding windows in [task_start, task_start+acclimation_ms) only, then apply pipeline scaler.

firing_policy.selection_rule: maximize pct_tasks_fired subject to false_fire_rate <= 30%, break ties by median_lead_time_s

sa_classifier_metadata.deployment_logic: 1. Scale features using sa_classifier.scaler_mean/scale. 2. Compute probabilities P for all classes. 3. If P[sa3_class_index] >= sa3_threshold, return 3. 4. Else, return class with highest remaining probability.
